annotations.title: Transpose guitar chords to a new key

description: Moves a song's chords to a new key. Accepts a chord list, a chord chart with lyrics (chord lines are transposed, lyric lines are kept), or inline [C] chords. Give either from_key and to_key, or a number of semitones. Also suggests capo positions that let the guitarist keep easy open shapes in the new key.

from_key.description: Current key, e.g. "G" or "A minor". Optional if semitones is given; if missing, the first chord is used.

semitones.description: Semitones to move (+ up, - down). Used when to_key is not given.

spelling.description: Accidentals for the result. auto follows the target key.

text.description: The chords or chord chart, e.g. "G D Em C" or a chart with chord lines above lyrics.

name: transpose_chords
title: Transpose guitar chords to a new key
